claims.text: Experiments are conducted using the IWSLT14 German-to-English task with a dataset of 153K/7K/7K sentence pairs, employing a Transformer architecture with specific configurations.
The experiments are repeated ten times using different random seeds to ensure consistency in results.
The performance of the models is evaluated using validation loss and BLEU scores as metrics.
For pre-training, the English Wikipedia corpus and BookCorpus are used, with a training-validation ratio of 199:1.
